chunks: They are those who will surely have their share of whatsoever they have earned; for God is swift at the reckoning.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is swift at the reckoning?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of individual accountability, affirming that each person bears the weight of their own actions without intercession or shared burden. It serves as a reminder of Allah's attribute of *Sari' al-Hisab* (Swift in Reckoning), encouraging believers to maintain constant mindfulness (*Muraqabah*) of their deeds. This concept reinforces the justice (*Adl*) of God, ensuring that no soul is wronged even by the weight of a mustard seed.
